#### Description
missing MIRROR_INGRESS_ACTION and MIRROR_EGRESS_ACTION in sonic-acl.yang
which is used for EverflowAlwaysOn in Generic Config Updater E2E test.
<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. 
```
admin@vlab-01:~/everflow$ sudo config acl add table EVERFLOW_DSCP MIRROR_DSCP

admin@vlab-01:~/everflow$ sudo config apply-patch -i /FEATURE -i /QUEUE -i /SCHEDULER add_rule.json
Patch Applier: Patch application starting.
Patch Applier: Patch: [{"op": "add", "path": "/ACL_RULE", "value": {"EVERFLOW_DSCP|RULE_1": {"DSCP": "5", "MIRROR_INGRESS_ACTION": "mirror_session_dscp", "PRIORITY": "9999"}}}]
Patch Applier: Getting current config db.
Patch Applier: Simulating the target full config after applying the patch.
Patch Applier: Validating target config does not have empty tables, since they do not show up in ConfigDb.
Patch Applier: Sorting patch updates.
Note: Below table(s) have no YANG models:
BGP_PEER_RANGE, CONSOLE_SWITCH, DEVICE_NEIGHBOR_METADATA, DHCP_SERVER, KDUMP, RESTAPI, SNMP, SNMP_COMMUNITY, TELEMETRY,
sonic_yang(3):All Keys are not parsed in ACL_RULE
dict_keys(['EVERFLOW_DSCP|RULE_1'])
sonic_yang(3):exceptionList:["'MIRROR_INGRESS_ACTION'"]   <=====================
sonic_yang(3):Data Loading Failed:All Keys are not parsed in ACL_RULE
dict_keys(['EVERFLOW_DSCP|RULE_1'])
Failed to apply patch
Usage: config apply-patch [OPTIONS] PATCH_FILE_PATH
Try "config apply-patch -h" for help.

Error: Given patch is not valid because it will result in an invalid config
```

3.

comments.author: stepanblyschak
comments.body:
Hi @qiluo-msft , in yang model ACL_TABLE_TYPE/actions is a leaf-list of strings [here](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/09b0cc2ccef41bf0fbb0fa4d42bca28f37e13f59/src/sonic-yang-models/yang-templates/sonic-acl.yang.j2#L269).

But how it is related to this issue? This issue is due to ACL_RULE yang container not defining all actions that are supported by orchagent including:
- ACTION_REDIRECT_ACTION
- ACTION_DO_NOT_NAT_ACTION
- ACTION_MIRROR_INGRESS_ACTION
- ACTION_MIRROR_EGRESS_ACTION
- ACTION_DTEL_FLOW_OP
- ACTION_DTEL_INT_SESSION
- ACTION_DTEL_DROP_REPORT_ENABLE
- ACTION_DTEL_TAIL_DROP_REPORT_ENABLE
- ACTION_DTEL_FLOW_SAMPLE_PERCENT
- ACTION_DTEL_REPORT_ALL_PACKETS

#### How to verify it
Run the YANG model unit tests
